THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Fluffy Scrambled Eggs (Three Hacks)

Three simple technique changes for soft, custardy scrambled eggs my kids loved: thorough bowl whisking, gentle low-heat spatula folds in butter, and a 1 tbsp whipped cream cheese finish. About 150 cal and 10g protein per half-batch portion.

YIELD2 servings
TOTAL TIME5 min
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~150 cal | ~10g protein

Ingredients

EGG BATCH (MAKES 2 PORTIONS)

  • 3 whole large eggs
  • 1/2 tbsp butter (for the entire pan)
  • 1 tbsp whipped cream cheese (~10g, optional; used in filmed batch)
  • Salt, to taste (added at the end)

TO SERVE (COUNTED SEPARATELY)

  • Classic white bread for kids, or keto/protein bread for adults

Allergens: egg, dairy.

Method

  1. 1.HACK 1 — WHISK THOROUGHLY. Crack 3 large eggs into a bowl and whisk until the yolks and whites are completely uniform with zero separate streaks of white.
  2. 2.MELT BUTTER OVER LOW HEAT. Warm a nonstick skillet over gentle low heat and melt 1/2 tbsp butter across the surface, then pour in the whisked eggs.
  3. 3.HACK 2 — PUSH & FOLD. Let the eggs begin to set slightly, then gently push and fold across the pan with a silicone spatula to form soft, ribboned curds instead of scrambling frantically.
  4. 4.HACK 3 — FOLD IN WHIPPED CREAM CHEESE. Just before the eggs finish setting, add 1 tbsp whipped cream cheese and fold gently over low/off heat until melted and no liquid egg remains.
  5. 5.SALT AT THE END & PLATE. Season with salt to taste at the very end so you can judge the saltiness with the cheese, then divide between two plates.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult: Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid: Serve the kid portion as described above.

Storage and reheating

Store: Best cooked and eaten fresh in 5 minutes; scrambled eggs lose their soft custard texture when refrigerated.

Reheat: Warm gently in 15-second microwave bursts at 50% power so the curds do not toughen.

Lasts: Best fresh; up to 2 days refrigerated in an airtight container if needed.

Estimated nutrition

~150 cal | ~10g protein per 1/2 batch (1.5 eggs + half of pan butter and cream cheese; bread excluded).

Per half batch (bread excluded): ~150 calories, 10g protein, 12g fat, 1g carbs with all pan butter and 1 tbsp whipped cream cheese (~10g USDA generic measure). Eggs alone contribute ~108 calories and 9.5g protein per half batch (~133 cal with butter, without cream cheese). Whole 3-egg pan is ~302 calories and ~19.6g protein.
